name: Chris – ensemble with cutoff search

validation.description: Last 2,000 training transactions (31 Jul - 31 Aug 2026). The 0.62 cutoff was chosen on this same holdout, so this score is optimistic

notes: Voting ensemble (gradient boosting, random forest, extra trees) with time-of-day and calendar features. Searches cutoffs from 0.05 to 0.80 and keeps the one that scores best on the holdout: very few false alarms (precision 98.6%), slightly more missed fraud.
